interpretations: For each circuit country, average the season-to-date points and wins across all constructor standings records at races held there; subtract the unweighted mean of the countries’ average wins from that country’s average wins.

For each circuit country, average the season-to-date points and wins across all constructor standings records at races held there; subtract the overall average wins across those records from that country’s average wins.

For each circuit country, calculate the average season-to-date points and wins at each race, then average those race figures within the country; compare its average wins with the unweighted mean of the country averages.

For each circuit country, first average each constructor’s season-to-date points and wins across its races there, then average those constructor figures; compare its average wins with the unweighted mean of the country averages.
For each circuit country, average season-to-date points and wins only for constructors that entered races there; compare its average wins with the unweighted mean of the country averages.

For each circuit country, calculate separate averages for each season in which it hosted a race, then average those season figures; compare its average wins with the unweighted mean of the country averages.

For each circuit country, first average the season-to-date points and wins at each circuit, then average the circuit figures so each circuit has equal weight; compare its average wins with the unweighted mean of the country averages.

For each circuit country, average each constructor’s season-to-date points and wins separately within each season, then average those constructor-season figures; compare its average wins with the unweighted mean of the country averages.

For each circuit country, average the season-to-date points and wins at each race, then average those race figures within the country; compare its average wins with the average across all races, giving each race equal weight.
queries:
WITH country_averages AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        AVG(cs.points) AS average_points,
        AVG(cs.wins) AS average_wins
    FROM constructorStandings AS cs
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT
    country,
    average_points,
    average_wins,
    average_wins - (SELECT AVG(average_wins) FROM country_averages) AS wins_difference
FROM country_averages

WITH standings_by_country AS (
    SELECT c.country, cs.points, cs.wins
    FROM constructorStandings AS cs
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
)
SELECT
    country,
    AVG(points) AS average_points,
    AVG(wins) - (SELECT AVG(wins) FROM standings_by_country) AS wins_above_overall_average
FROM standings_by_country
GROUP BY country;

WITH race_averages AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        r.raceId,
        AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points,
        AVG(ds.wins) AS avg_wins
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        AVG(avg_points) AS avg_points,
        AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins
    FROM race_averages
    GROUP BY country
)
SELECT
    country,
    avg_points,
    avg_wins,
    avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_averages) AS wins_vs_country_mean
FROM country_averages

WITH constructor_country AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        cs.constructorId,
        AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points,
        AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
    FROM constructorStandings AS cs
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    GROUP BY c.country, cs.constructorId
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        AVG(avg_points) AS avg_points,
        AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins
    FROM constructor_country
    GROUP BY country
)
SELECT
    country,
    avg_points,
    avg_wins,
    CASE
        WHEN avg_wins > (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_averages) THEN 'above'
        WHEN avg_wins < (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_averages) THEN 'below'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS wins_comparison
FROM country_averages

WITH country_averages AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points,
        AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
    FROM constructorStandings AS cs
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM results AS res
        WHERE res.raceId = cs.raceId
          AND res.constructorId = cs.constructorId
    )
    GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT
    country,
    avg_points,
    avg_wins,
    avg_wins - AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS wins_vs_country_mean
FROM country_averages

WITH country_season AS (
    SELECT c.country, r.year, AVG(ds.wins) AS average_wins
    FROM circuits AS c
    JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY c.country, r.year
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT country, AVG(average_wins) AS average_wins
    FROM country_season
    GROUP BY country
)
SELECT country,
       average_wins,
       average_wins - (SELECT AVG(average_wins) FROM country_averages) AS difference_from_country_mean
FROM country_averages
